root_cause.classification: pre-existing source ownership behavior exposed by an internally incompatible tiny raw-reference gate; not a direct-integration candidate regression
root_cause.mechanism: Replicated raw calls MuonAdamW._muon_step once on each complete tiny Muon group, while OwnedOptimizer partitions each group by owner and invokes the same compiled body on smaller per-rank subsets, padding only singleton subsets. The child logs prove distinct Neuron graph shapes: raw compiled (8,32,32) and (6,32,64), while source/direct rank 0 compiled (2,32,32) and (2,32,64), with other owner cardinalities determined by the plan. The mathematically batch-independent update is not byte-invariant under those different small compiled batch shapes: the six square-matrix parameters and six rectangular second-moment rows above differ from replicated raw.
root_cause.direct_refactor_evidence: For every rank, source-adapter fixtures equal direct fixtures byte for byte, including all parameters, state, plans, scalars and snapshots. The source adapter and direct class share the same make_plan and OwnedOptimizer implementation; direct only removes the runtime installation wrapper.
root_cause.production_evidence: For the exact fs-w62 width-1024 inventory, raw, source and direct match across all four scheduled steps, including None gradients, zero gradients, skipped AdamW, changed hyperparameters, merged persistent state, cross-rank digests and Linear cache/output checks.
root_cause.low_level_limit: The evidence identifies the changed compiled batch dimension and the exact affected outputs. It does not expose compiler-internal reduction/lowering order, so no narrower compiler implementation claim is made.

reference_triangle.consequence: The current gate simultaneously demands direct==source and direct==raw for the same tiny inputs even though source!=raw. No candidate implementation can satisfy both exact equalities. This is an unsatisfiable validation contract for the frozen source, not evidence that the direct refactor changed source semantics.

candidate_decision.recommendation: ABANDON the current direct-review-safe proposal rather than mutate the candidate after this result.
rationale: The approved proposal permits only direct integration of frozen source arithmetic and explicitly forbids math changes.
Current direct already reproduces frozen source exactly on every observed CE and optimizer fixture.
Changing direct to match tiny raw would necessarily break the simultaneously required exact source comparison because frozen source and raw are already unequal there.

Padding every owned Muon subset to the original full group shape or redesigning ownership could target raw equality, but would change memory, compilation, performance and optimizer execution; it is a new experiment, not a minimal review-safe refactor.

rerun_policy.reason: An unchanged rerun would exercise the same deterministic reference conflict and cannot turn this valid terminal FAIL into a pass.
only_legitimate_future_paths: A new human-approved proposal may redesign OwnedOptimizer with replicated-raw byte equality as the target, followed by new CPU/static, component, throughput, cold-training and quality controls.

Alternatively, a new independently reviewed validation proposal may make frozen source/direct exactness and launch-shape production raw equality decisive while treating nonproduction tiny batch-shape raw differences as diagnostics. That would be a prospective gate redesign, not a reinterpretation or rescue of r3.

independent_postflight_blocker.consequence: Any future hardware proposal also requires an independently authorized capacity remedy and a fresh passing preflight/postflight; the preserved r3 failure must not be deleted or relabeled.

scientific_conclusion: r3 proves the review-safe direct integration reproduces its frozen source on the exercised Neuron paths, but the predeclared discriminator and postflight still fail. It does not authorize training, submission, a relaxed gate, or a private-score claim.
